text:
He should be found guilty of reckless endangerment or a similar reckless offense, not an intentional crime, because he consciously disregarded a substantial and unjustifiable risk by speeding on a busy street. His admission of indifference to the consequences supports a finding of recklessness (or possibly depraved-heart murder if the risk was extreme enough), but not intent to injure.  
CONFIDENCE: 85
